title: Entering the Era of Discrete Diffusion Models: A Benchmark for Schrodinger Bridges and Entropic Optimal Transport
one_line_en: First benchmark with analytically known solutions for discrete-space EOT/SB: any (p_0, v*) yields a pair (p_0, p_1) with closed-form optimal coupling (Theorem 3.1), made tractable in S^D via CP parameterization; by-product solvers DLightSB / DLightSB-M / alpha-CSBM, with DLightSB strongest across all settings.
one_line_zh: 离散空间 EOT/SB 第一个有解析解的基准：任意 (p_0, v*) 诱导出闭式最优耦合的基准对（Theorem 3.1），CP 参数化使它在 S^D 高维可算；副产品求解器 DLightSB 全设定最强；任何熵正则 GFN-OT 都必须在此报数。
